description: Make dashboard factory PNG import session-aware so activation PUTs to /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory for the selected workspace tab instead of POST /factories, with unit, functional, and browser integration tests proving correct endpoints, payloads, and session isolation.

context.customerAsk: Customers want to import factories on any factory tab. Import currently POSTs /factories and updates the default factory directory even on the second tab. Make import derive context from the active session and submit to factory-sessions/{session-id}/factory, and add functional and integration tests for the non-default tab import path.
context.problem: useFactoryImportActivation defaults to createFactory which POSTs /factories globally. The dashboard tracks selectedSessionID for export and saves but not import, so operators on a second live factory session see import mutate the wrong factory root and runtime.
context.solution: Add session-scoped import activation that GETs the current factory for the selected session, adapts the imported payload for name and version, PUTs to the session factory endpoint, wire selectedSessionID through the dashboard import controller, update app-shell tests, and add backend functional plus UI browser integration tests for second-tab import.

acceptanceCriteria: Import on the default session tab activates via PUT /factory-sessions/~default/factory with versioned canonical payload, not POST /factories.
Import on a non-default session tab activates via PUT /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory and does not call POST /factories.
Non-default session import updates only that session factory definition and on-disk directory; the default session factory is unchanged.
Import preview and activation error states continue to work with existing accessible dialog behavior.
Unit tests assert correct activation method, path, and body per selected session.
Backend functional and UI integration tests exercise the second-tab import path.
Quality gate: backend and frontend typecheck, lint, and relevant tests pass before merge.

userStories.title: Session-scoped factory import activation client
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want PNG import activation to save through my active session current-factory endpoint so import updates the factory I am viewing.
acceptanceCriteria: Session-aware activation reads the current factory document for the supplied sessionID, preserves the session current factory name on the imported payload, includes version metadata per saveCurrentFactoryDocument rules, and PUTs to /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory.
Activation for ~default uses /factory-sessions/~default/factory; activation for a non-default session uses that session path.
Activation does not call POST /factories.
Structured failures such as FACTORY_NOT_IDLE and STALE_FACTORY_VERSION surface through the existing import activation error state.
API client unit tests assert method, path, and JSON body for default and non-default session IDs.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

Switching the selected session tab before confirming import activates against the newly selected session without a page reload.
useFactoryImportActivation uses session-scoped activation by default instead of createFactory.
Hook-level tests cover session ID propagation into the activation dependency.
